component.name: VioraEDA
component.summary: Modern Electronic Design Automation & SPICE Simulation Suite

description.p: VioraEDA is a high-performance Electronic Design Automation (EDA) suite integrating schematic capture, analog and digital SPICE simulation, mixed-signal co-simulation (VioAVR, VioMATRIXC, digital.cm), PCB layout with 3D ray-traced visualization, and automated Gerber/PDF manufacturing exports.

ul.li: Fast interactive mixed-signal simulation engine powered by ngspice and native JIT compilation
Smart Signal generators with embedded FluxScript scripting
Cross-platform schematic capture (.flxsch) with netlist-first synchronization
Advanced PCB Layout, interactive routing, teardrop generation, and automated Design Rule Checking (DRC)
Full CLI daemon with headless batch processing, ERC, and live web preview

description.p: Production release with enhanced Linux installer, full cross-platform path portability, and high-performance simulation.
